## New
- **Full preview.** Press Space on a clip to see the whole text or the full-size image. Press Space or Esc to close it. - **Private categories.** Right-click a category and make it private. Its clips stay hidden, also from search, until you unlock it with Touch ID or your Mac password. It stays unlocked for one minute. - **Category icons.** Right-click a category to give it an emoji. - **More card types.** Emails, phone numbers, dates, addresses and JSON each get their own card. - **Link titles.** A copied link shows the title of its page when the browser gives one. Nothing is fetched from the internet. - **Most used.** Each card counts how often you used it, and the filter menu can sort by it. - **Status in Settings.** Settings now shows whether recording, pasting, updates and history are working. - **Install with Homebrew.** See the README for the three commands.

## New - **New clip.** Type a clip by hand with Cmd+N, the pencil button, or **New Clip…** in the menu-bar menu. - **Undo delete.** Press Cmd+Z after a delete, while the shelf is still open. - **Merge clips.** Select several text clips and press Cmd+J to combine them into one. - **Copy text from an image.** Shift+Cmd+C copies the words Cpaste read in a screenshot. - **Pause recording** from the menu-bar menu, for 5 minutes, an hour, or until you resume. - **Export and import.** Save every category with its clips to one file, in Settings. - **Shelf on the right.** Choose a side drawer in Settings, General, Shelf. - **Slide animation** when the shelf opens and closes. - Long text fades out on its card and says how many lines are hidden.
## Install Already on 0.1.6? Choose **Check for Updates…** in the Cpaste menu. Otherwise download `Cpaste.zip` below and follow the README. Apple Silicon Macs only.

## New - **Updates inside the app.** Cpaste checks once a day and shows **Update to Cpaste…** in its menu when a new version is out. One click installs it. Turn the check off in Settings, General. - **Smarter cards.** A link shows its site name. A colour code shows a swatch. Commands and code use a monospace font. An image fills the card and shows a few words read from it. A file shows its Finder icon and size.
## Updating from 0.1.5 or older Download `Cpaste.zip` below and replace the app by hand one last time. From this version on, updates arrive inside Cpaste.
## Install Download `Cpaste.zip` below and follow the README. Apple Silicon Macs only.
